description: Final operational documentation consolidation - MCP setup and E2E triage guides

entities.name: DevTools_MCP_Getting_Started_Guide
observations: Purpose: Configure Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for local VS Code development
Workspace Config: .vscode/mcp.json (primary), .mcp.json, .opencode/mcp.json, .kiro/settings/mcp.json, .junie/mcp/mcp.json
Security: Sensitive API keys NOT stored in repository - use VS Code input prompts or environment variables
Default State: Third-party servers (Firecrawl, Context7, DeepL) disabled by default - enable in VS Code settings
Laravel Boost: Uses local Artisan command for Laravel-specific capabilities (tinker, artisan commands, database schema)
Quick Setup: 1) Open workspace in VS Code, 2) Install MCP extension, 3) Set API keys via prompts or user-level config, 4) Start servers via MCP UI
Required API Keys: FIRECRAWL_API_KEY, CONTEXT7_API_KEY, DEEPL_API_KEY
User-Level Config Example: C:\Users\<username>\.kiro\settings\mcp.json with mcpServers object
Core Servers: memory, laravel-boost, playwright, chrome-devtools, sequentialthinking
Memory Storage: C:\XAMPP\htdocs\ictserve-031125\storage\mcp\memory.jsonl (persistent file)
Enabling Servers: Command palette > MCP: Start Server <server-name> or use MCP extension UI
Troubleshooting: Check server cwd, ensure required programs (php, npx, uvx) in PATH
Laravel Boost Requirements: php in PATH, Laravel repo available in cwd (C:\XAMPP\htdocs\ictserve-031125)
Memory Server: Uses @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory, npx downloads automatically
Security Best Practice: Do not commit API keys/secrets to source control, use $input:* placeholders for prompts
Implementation: .vscode/mcp.json contains complete server set, sensitive keys removed from .opencode/.junie/.kiro with $input: placeholders
Related: DEVELOPERS_MCP.md (IDE-specific setup), GITHUB_MCP_SETUP.md (GitHub MCP server)

entities.name: Helpdesk_Performance_Triage_Guide
observations: Purpose: Capture performance failures from Playwright E2E tests and provide fix recommendations
Test File: tests/e2e/helpdesk-performance.refactored.spec.ts
Failing Tests: 02 (ticket list load time), 03 (form load time), 10 (Time to Interactive TTI)
Impact: Slow LCP/TTI negatively affects UX and SEO, slow form load reduces conversions
Reproduction: 1) Start dev server (php artisan serve or npm run dev), 2) Run npx playwright test with --grep @performance, 3) Inspect test-results/ artifacts
Common Causes: Large JS bundles, large image assets, uncached assets, slow server response, too many network requests
Fix: Code splitting and lazy loading for non-critical components
Fix: Optimize images (WebP/AVIF), add loading=lazy attribute
Fix: Set Cache-Control headers for static assets (server or CDN)
Fix: Profile backend endpoints, add database indexes, optimize queries (avoid N+1), cache frequently-used data
Fix: Consolidate network requests, debounce or batch requests
Suggested Owners: @frontend (bundle/image optimization) and @backend (API performance, DB queries)
Quick Wins: Server-side caching for ticket lists, lazy-loading for images/widgets, Lighthouse CI job for LCP/TTI baseline
Next Steps: Create issues for JS bundle optimization, image optimization, caching ticket list; add Lighthouse/metrics job in .github/workflows
Traceability: D03-FR-007.2 (Performance Requirements), D11 (Technical Design), D00 (System Overview)

entities.name: Loan_Accessibility_Triage_Guide
observations: Purpose: Capture accessibility problems from Playwright E2E axe checks during refactored tests
Test File: tests/e2e/loan-module-accessibility.refactored.spec.ts
Failing Rules: color-contrast (WCAG 2.2 AA 4.5:1), color-contrast-enhanced (WCAG AAA 7:1), aria-required-children, aria-required-parent, aria-valid-attr-value, aria-hidden-focus
Example Violation: Text color #64748b on #0b1224 background (receipt date) - insufficient contrast
Impact: Color contrast creates readability issues for visually impaired users, ARIA misconfigurations cause screen reader errors
Reproduction: Run npx playwright test tests/e2e/loan-module-accessibility.refactored.spec.ts --grep @accessibility, inspect test-results/axe-results.json
Fix: Change design tokens to meet minimum contrast ratios (e.g., text-slate-400 -> text-slate-300)
Fix: Wrap role=tab with parent role=tablist, ensure aria-controls points to valid panel id
Fix: Set tabindex=-1 on non-visible elements or remove focusable children from aria-hidden regions
Fix: Add aria-label or aria-labelledby to nav/dialog/modal components
Suggested Owners: @frontend (Tailwind CSS + UI components) and @UX (color trade-off decisions)
Severity: High (critical/major for ARIA failures)
Next Steps: Create triage issues for each rule with example selectors from axe output, fix UI components in resources/views or app/Livewire, add visual regression tests
Traceability: D12 (UI/UX Accessibility), D14 (Style Guide), D03-FR-008 (Accessibility Requirements)

entities.name: Loan_Performance_Triage_Guide
observations: Purpose: Record performance regressions from Playwright E2E tests for loan module with fix suggestions
Test File: tests/e2e/loan-module-performance.refactored.spec.ts
Failing Tests: 02 (guest loan form load 26.7s), 07 (TTI 11.7s), 11 (form submission 404)
Reproduction: Run npx playwright test tests/e2e/loan-module-performance.refactored.spec.ts --grep @performance, check server logs for /loans/request and api/loans endpoints
Common Causes: Missing front-end page (/loans/request 404), large asset sizes, inefficient database queries, uncached API endpoints, CI environment timeouts
Fix: Implement or route /loans/request to correct Livewire or Blade view
Fix: Optimize images, compress/serve via CDN, implement tree-shaking for JS
Fix: Add ->with() eager loading to avoid N+1 queries, use profiler or Telescope to capture SQL queries
Fix: Add caching for non-sensitive list endpoints (short cache time), consider Redis
Fix: Add timeouts or use environment-aware thresholds for CI
Suggested Owners: @backend (route fixes, API optimization) + @frontend (rendering, bundle size)
Next Steps: Create issues for 404 page, slow API, bundle size with screenshots and trace; add Lighthouse to nightly jobs for TTI/LCP tracking
Traceability: D03-FR-007.2 (Performance Requirements), D11 (Technical Design)
